heard: Earth would keep orbiting if the sun became a black hole. Most people assume a stellar collapse creates an instant cosmic vacuum cleaner. A black hole is an astronomical body so compact that its gravity prevents anything, including light, from escaping. The boundary of no escape around a black hole is called the event horizon. Yet from far away, the external gravitational field of a black hole is identical to that of any other body of the same mass. Our solar system would get much colder because the black hole emits no visible sunlight, but the planets would stay in their orbits. Earth would keep orbiting normally.
